title: Zika Virus: Risks and Precautions for Pregnant Women
excerpt: The Zika virus can pose serious risks to fetuses, and pregnant women need to know about the precautions and ways to minimize risks.
content:
## Introduction to Zika Virus
The Zika virus is a type of virus transmitted through mosquitoes and can pose serious risks to fetuses. Pregnant women or those planning to become pregnant need to know about the precautions and ways to minimize risks.

## Risks of Zika Virus to Fetuses
The Zika virus can pose serious risks to fetuses, including:
* Brain and nervous system defects
* Vision and hearing defects
* Bone and muscle defects
* Developmental and behavioral disorders

## Precautions for Pregnant Women
To minimize the risks of Zika virus, pregnant women need to take the following precautions:
* Avoid traveling to areas with Zika virus outbreaks
* Use mosquito repellents and wear protective clothing when outdoors
* Avoid mosquito bites and use mosquito nets when sleeping
* Wash hands frequently and maintain good hygiene

## Precautions for Men
Men also need to take precautions to minimize the risks of Zika virus, including:
* Avoiding travel to areas with Zika virus outbreaks
* Using mosquito repellents and wearing protective clothing when outdoors
* Avoiding mosquito bites and using mosquito nets when sleeping
* Washing hands frequently and maintaining good hygiene

## Planning Pregnancy After Travel
If you have traveled to areas with Zika virus outbreaks, you need to plan your pregnancy carefully. You should:
* Avoid becoming pregnant for at least 2 months after returning
* Take precautions to minimize the risks of Zika virus
* Consult with your doctor before becoming pregnant

## Testing and Resources
If you suspect you have been infected with Zika virus, you need to undergo testing and consult with your doctor. You can also find resources and information about Zika virus on the websites of the Ministry of Health and other health organizations.

To learn more about the precautions and ways to minimize the risks of Zika virus, you can visit the [Ministry of Health website](https://www.canada.ca/en/public-health/services/diseases/zika-virus.html) or consult with your doctor.

## Conclusion
The Zika virus is a serious virus that can pose risks to fetuses. Pregnant women or those planning to become pregnant need to know about the precautions and ways to minimize risks. By taking precautions and consulting with your doctor, you can minimize the risks of Zika virus and protect your health and the health of your fetus.
